profile.headline: Software Engineer  at CACI International Inc
profile.summary:
Self-Motivated, customer focused, passionate professional with 30+ years’ experience and good reputation for delivering high quality work on time. 
About 20 years of experience providing Tier 3 and Tier 4 technical support addressing various RAN related concerns of wireless service providers and help deliver the best possible user experience to the end-users. While investigating complex field issues, deploying variety of tools like: scripting to process large amount of data, using excel, Power point to organize and communicate with customer.  Fluent with various software languages/OS -- including C, C++, Shell, Unix, Linux, Perl, awk, python etc. With strong communication skills, ability to dive into unfamiliar technical areas on short notice making significant contribution to the reputation and bottom line of the service provided. Recognizing importance of cooperation and collaboration with many stakeholders, strong team contributor to efficiently achieve desired end results.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Resolved the top performance concerns reported by telecom service providers related to the most current Nokia eNB SW. The Nokia LTE eNB SW is a complex SW written in C++ built with best in class SW development processes. Studied performance data, KPI reports, configuration, logs and call traces to identify deficiencies in the LTE RAN SW impacting the user experience of the wireless service. Presented solutions, workarounds, and status to the customer and executive teams. 
•	Identified root causes and resolved many performance issues – like higher call drop rates, higher handover failures, and call rejections due to overload conditions. For the SW issues, introduced SW corrections using specific SW processes.
•	Supported resolutions of performance issues observed just after the migration of thousands of Nokia eNBs.
•	Investigated poor mobility KPIs of various eNBs coming from configuration issues.
•	Enhanced trace collection capabilities to capture relevant information during to facilitate faster resolutions of issues. 
•	Provided scripts to quickly identify potential configuration issues.
•	Validated critical software fixes after their availability in the field using detailed traces.
•	Conducted an extensive study of accessibility-related traces to understand the subtle differences with possible impact on the accessibility KPIs.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provided Tier 3/4 technical support for CDMA Base Station field issues. The Nokia eNB SW is a complex SW written in C++. Implemented fast features, participated in technical reviews of many features and supported FOA activities for the new SW releases. The field support activities included investigations of customer concerns related RF resource management, neighbor list manager, handoff decisions and processing, interactions among various network elements, and performance metrics
•	Initiated a task force that delivered field debugging capabilities (CCPHOOK) that led to a significant reduction in the cost of field support and improved confidence in troubleshooting efforts.
o	Resolved many unresolved SW issues that were present for many years.
•	Supported pre-planning to meet challenges of unusually high demand events like Super Bowl, New Year Eve and participated in post-analysis of logs and traces to identify opportunities for improvement. 
o	Identified SW issue that led to the massive blocking of incoming calls at the busy base stations during New Year Eve’s celebration.
•	Analyzed field traces, logs and configuration files to identify the root cause of top priority field problems reported by customers. 
•	Introduced SW fixes for the issues identified during field support activities.
o	Typical issues are related to RF optimization, temporary spikes in service demands, Handoffs, Paging, Registration, Call Setup, Call Release, Service Measurements, etc.

CDMA Flexent Wireless Network Software Engineer 	1997 to 2000
Ported Lucent CDMA SII Platform product to CDMA Flexent Platform and incorporating new hardware and software elements.
•	Ported RCC product to ANSI-C compliant compiler.
•	Ported call processing functionalities to the FLEXENT platform including getting first call to work, test it in lab etc.
•	Supported the initial release of the FLEXENT platform through system test, FOA, and GA support.

Ported Lucent CDMA SII Platform product to CDMA Flexent Platform and incorporating new hardware and software elements.
•	Ported RCC product to ANSI-C compliant compiler.
